# muxt --version prints what muxt version prints.
muxt --version
stdout '^\(devel\)|v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+.*$'
! stderr .

# -v is accepted by every command that lists or explores, as it is by check.
muxt list-template-calls -v
! stderr 'unknown shorthand flag'
muxt list-template-callers -v
! stderr 'unknown shorthand flag'
muxt explore-module -v
! stderr 'unknown shorthand flag'
! muxt generate-fake-server -v
! stderr 'unknown shorthand flag'
